All your eligible U earns the base APR. Grow your holdings or trade U pairs to earn a higher APR on part or all of your U.
U Boost Details
Base
Hold U in any eligible account
All your eligible U earns the base APR. Eligible U is the U you own, after deducting any U you have borrowed and any U bought with borrowed stablecoins.
New Holding Bonus
Hold more U than your own average over the previous 3 weeks

The additional amount above your average ("New U") earns 1.5x. U bought with newly deposited funds, or with USDT, BTC, fiat or any other asset you own, counts in full. Converting USDC, USD1, RLUSD, FDUSD or XUSD already on Binance into U does not count as New U. U received from other Binance users does not count as New U.
1.5x Base APR
Trading Bonus
Trade at least 2,500 U-equivalent of U pairs in a week

Trading volume across Spot, Margin and Futures is combined. U-versus-stablecoin pairs do not count. Once you reach the threshold, your eligible U held outside Simple Earn ("Trading U") earns 1.3x for the full week.
1.3x Base APR
New + Trading
Meet both conditions above
U that is both New U and Trading U earns 1.8x.
1.8x Base APR
U in Simple Earn Flexible Products continues to earn its own Real-Time APR, which is paid separately under Simple Earn terms. Campaign rewards are separate from the Real-Time APR.
Eligible Accounts
Spot Account,
Funding Account,
Simple Earn Flexible Holdings,
Margin Account (Cross Margin, Isolated Margin or Portfolio Margin),
USDⓈ-M Futures Account (account balance only, Multi-Assets mode included; unrealized PnL is excluded).
U-pair trading volume is counted across Spot, Margin and Futures Accounts combined. U-versus-stablecoin pairs do not count.
What Counts
Only your own U counts. Any U you have borrowed does not qualify under the campaign rules.
U funded by borrowed stablecoins does not count. If you borrow USDT, USDC, USD1, RLUSD, FDUSD or XUSD and no longer hold it, the amount you no longer hold is deducted from your U.

Switching between stablecoins is not new U. Converting USDC, USD1, RLUSD, FDUSD or XUSD already on Binance into U does not earn the New Holding Bonus. U bought with newly deposited funds, or with USDT, BTC, fiat or any other asset you own, counts in full.
U received from other users is not New U. U received from other Binance accounts earns the base APR but does not earn the New Holding Bonus.

Balances are checked every hour. Your lowest balance of the day is counted as your daily balance for the purposes of this campaign, and your weekly balance is the average of the 7 daily balances. A day with no balance counts as zero.
Effective APR (to be updated after each weekly distribution)
New Holding 1.5x APR
Trading 1.3x APR
New + Trading 1.8x APR

Examples
The examples below assume a base APR of 5% for illustration only. The actual effective APR for each week will be published after that week's distribution.
User A holds 10,000 U all week and held none in the previous 3 weeks. User A does not trade U pairs. All 10,000 U is New U and earns 1.5x.

User B has held 10,000 U and 10,000 USDC for the past 3 weeks, then converts the USDC into U and holds 20,000 U all week. This is a switch between stablecoins, so it is not New U. All 20,000 U earns 1x.

User C holds 1,000 U, borrows 4,000 USDT through Margin to buy 4,000 more U, and trades 3,000 U-equivalent of U pairs. User C held no U in the previous 3 weeks. The 4,000 U bought with borrowed USDT does not count. The remaining 1,000 U is both New U and Trading U, so it earns 1.8x.

User D has kept 8,000 U in Simple Earn and 2,000 U in Spot for the past 3 weeks, unchanged, and trades 3,000 U-equivalent of U pairs this week. The 2,000 U in Spot earns 1.3x. The 8,000 U in Simple Earn earns 1x.
Reward = (8,000 * 1 + 2,000 * 1.3) * 5% * 7 / 365 = 10.16 U (Simple Earn's own yield is paid on top)

User E held no U in the previous 3 weeks. User E received 10,000 U from a friend’s Binance account, and User E holds it all week. The 10,000 U earns 1x, because U received from another Binance user is not New U.

Users' rewards depend on their eligible U, New U and Trading U relative to those of all eligible users, and other factors. The effective APRs will be published in this announcement after each weekly distribution.

Sub-accounts trading volumes are not counted as separate entries under this campaign. Sub-account balances and trading volume are aggregated at the master account level, and rewards are distributed only to the master account.
U borrowed through Margin or Loans (including interest), and any negative U balance in USDⓈ-M Futures, are treated as U liabilities and deducted from users’ U.

The same eligible accounts apply to all stablecoins. When checking net borrowing of stablecoins (USDT, USDC, USD1, RLUSD, FDUSD or XUSD), and when measuring holdings of USDC, USD1, RLUSD, FDUSD and XUSD, only balances in the eligible accounts above are counted.

For borrowed stablecoins (USDT, USDC, USD1, RLUSD, FDUSD and XUSD, including interest), the deduction is calculated for each coin separately. For example, if a user borrows 10,000 USDT and still holds 6,000 USDT, then 4,000 USDT will be deducted. Each liability is deducted only once across all their eligible accounts.

New U is measured against users’ own average over the 3 weeks before the current week. This reference amount is updated daily. If the user’s combined holdings of USDC, USD1, RLUSD, FDUSD and XUSD fall below their combined 3-week average, that drop is deducted from their New U.

The Trading Bonus applies for the full week once the user’s cumulative U-pair trading volume reaches 2,500 U-equivalent within that campaign week. Trading volume is counted in U-equivalent, with both buy and sell sides counted. U-versus-stablecoin pairs (USDT, USDC, USD1, RLUSD, FDUSD and XUSD) are excluded.
At any snapshot, an eligible U balance below 0.01 U will be counted as zero.
Rewards distributed are rounded down to 2 decimal places. There is no individual cap on rewards. Kindly note that the distribution time is not guaranteed and may change from time to time.
If Binance identifies any abuse of the campaign rules, the related rewards will be cancelled, and Binance may disqualify the account from the campaign.
Broker accounts are not eligible for this campaign.

Snapshots of user balances and total qualifying balances will be taken at any point of time each hour to get users’ hourly balances in the above mentioned account categories. The lowest balance captured during those snapshots on each day will constitute their Qualifying Balance and be used to calculate their rewards.
All calculations and determinations regarding this campaign (including but not limited to eligible balances, trading volume and reward distribution) will be made by Binance at its sole discretion.

Users are solely responsible for determining, declaring, and paying any taxes, duties, levies, or other charges that may arise in connection with any rewards they receive under this Campaign, and for complying with any applicable reporting obligations. Binance does not accept any liability for a user’s tax position or for any failure by a user to meet their own tax obligations. Examples
The examples below assume a base APR of 5% for illustration only. The actual effective APR for each week will be published after that week's distribution.
User A holds 10,000 U all week and held none in the previous 3 weeks. User A does not trade U pairs. All 10,000 U is New U and earns 1.5x.

User B has held 10,000 U and 10,000 USDC for the past 3 weeks, then converts the USDC into U and holds 20,000 U all week. This is a switch between stablecoins, so it is not New U. All 20,000 U earns 1x.

User C holds 1,000 U, borrows 4,000 USDT through Margin to buy 4,000 more U, and trades 3,000 U-equivalent of U pairs. User C held no U in the previous 3 weeks. The 4,000 U bought with borrowed USDT does not count. The remaining 1,000 U is both New U and Trading U, so it earns 1.8x.

User D has kept 8,000 U in Simple Earn and 2,000 U in Spot for the past 3 weeks, unchanged, and trades 3,000 U-equivalent of U pairs this week. The 2,000 U in Spot earns 1.3x. The 8,000 U in Simple Earn earns 1x.
Reward = (8,000 * 1 + 2,000 * 1.3) * 5% * 7 / 365 = 10.16 U (Simple Earn's own yield is paid on top)

User E held no U in the previous 3 weeks. User E received 10,000 U from a friend’s Binance account, and User E holds it all week. The 10,000 U earns 1x, because U received from another Binance user is not New U.

Sub-accounts trading volumes are not counted as separate entries under this campaign. Sub-account balances and trading volume are aggregated at the master account level, and rewards are distributed only to the master account.
U borrowed through Margin or Loans (including interest), and any negative U balance in USDⓈ-M Futures, are treated as U liabilities and deducted from users’ U.

The same eligible accounts apply to all stablecoins. When checking net borrowing of stablecoins (USDT, USDC, USD1, RLUSD, FDUSD or XUSD), and when measuring holdings of USDC, USD1, RLUSD, FDUSD and XUSD, only balances in the eligible accounts above are counted.

For borrowed stablecoins (USDT, USDC, USD1, RLUSD, FDUSD and XUSD, including interest), the deduction is calculated for each coin separately. For example, if a user borrows 10,000 USDT and still holds 6,000 USDT, then 4,000 USDT will be deducted. Each liability is deducted only once across all their eligible accounts.

New U is measured against users’ own average over the 3 weeks before the current week. This reference amount is updated daily. If the user’s combined holdings of USDC, USD1, RLUSD, FDUSD and XUSD fall below their combined 3-week average, that drop is deducted from their New U.

The Trading Bonus applies for the full week once the user’s cumulative U-pair trading volume reaches 2,500 U-equivalent within that campaign week. Trading volume is counted in U-equivalent, with both buy and sell sides counted. U-versus-stablecoin pairs (USDT, USDC, USD1, RLUSD, FDUSD and XUSD) are excluded.
